name: ai.buywhere/mcp
description: Agent-native product catalog: search 380M+ deduplicated products across US + SEA marketplaces, compare prices, find deals — with shipping-aware ranking (deliver_to), per-job attribution (shopping_job_id), and affiliate-tracked outbound links.

authentication.description: OAuth 2.1: dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) + client_credentials live; discovery at https://api.buywhere.ai/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server. Static bearer API keys also accepted (https://buywhere.ai/api-keys).

tools_summary.name: search_products
tools_summary.description: Keyword product search with deliver_to shipping ranking, price filters, sort, compact agent mode

tools_summary.name: get_product
tools_summary.description: Full product detail by id incl. resolved outbound_url

tools_summary.name: find_best_price
tools_summary.description: Cheapest offers for a product name per market
